# GOOD THINKING

> GOOD THINKING is a weekly newsletter and podcast on brand, marketing, and culture, read by 18K subscribers including top brand executives. It is written and hosted by Chris Danton and Kirsten Ludwig, Co-Founders of IN GOOD CO, a global brand consultancy built for challenger brands. They are keynote speakers on brand, culture, consumer trends, and the future of brand.

## Speaking

- [Speaking](https://getgoodthinking.com/speaking): Book Kirsten Ludwig and Chris Danton for keynotes, workshops, and hosted executive dinners. Includes talks, speaker bios, past stages, testimonials, and the booking form.
- [Press kit](https://getgoodthinking.com/speaking/press-kit): Bios in three lengths, approved photos, logos, talk topics, and press contact.
- [Press kit PDF](https://getgoodthinking.com/speaking/good-thinking-press-kit.pdf): Downloadable five-page press kit.

### Talks

- The Future Is Now: 10 culture trends and predictions for 2027, across culture, food & bev, alphas, silvers, retail, tech, sport, wellness, and travel.
- Thinking in Possibilities: breaking out of your category and taking hold of your brand's trajectory.
- The Age of Authorship: AI made building almost free; the hard part now is mattering.
- The Public CMO: why brand leaders are becoming public figures, and how to build a personal brand without the cringe.
- GOOD HARD TRUTHS: the GOOD THINKING lens pointed at your brand, with the honest read and real actions.

Formats: keynotes, firesides and panels, workshops, and closed-door CMO dinners.
Past stages: SXSW (Austin), Brands & Culture (New York), Paradigms, and private brand and leadership summits.

### Speakers

- Chris Danton (she/her): award-winning futurist, brand builder, author, speaker, and creative strategist. Co-Founder of IN GOOD CO and the writer and co-host of GOOD THINKING. Her expertise is leading the future of brand.
- Kirsten Ludwig (she/her): brand builder, cultural curator, and Co-Founder of IN GOOD CO. Co-host of the GOOD THINKING podcast and a top voice in brand. Her expertise is disrupting the status quo.
